text: {"lessons":["A gain feels good to lock in, but selling winners while holding losers can distort my portfolio; I should judge each position by its future risk and return, not my purchase price.","My recent trades and price history do not predict what comes next, so I should avoid buying or selling just because a stock has recently risen or fallen.","Before trading, I should consider the whole portfolio and keep enough diversification and cash rather than letting satisfaction or regret drive repeated trades."]}
